name: File Browser
description: Upload, download and share files on your server from any browser.

afterInstall.text: Open the Logs section on this page and find the line that mentions the password: that is the first-time admin password. It is shown only once, so note it down.
Click Open and log in with the username admin and that password.
Change the password right away under Settings, then User Management.
Files you upload are stored in the files folder listed under Data on this page.
